annotation.title_clean: Inicia en la República Dominicana la Tercera Cumbre Ministerial sobre la Ética de la Inteligencia Artificial en América Latina y el Caribe
annotation.title_en: Third Ministerial Summit on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence in Latin America and the Caribbean Begins in the Dominican Republic
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO news article on the Third Ministerial Summit on AI Ethics in Latin America and the Caribbean (Santo Domingo, 25–26 June 2026), organised with CAF and the Dominican OGTIC. Delegations from 20+ countries aim to implement the UNESCO Recommendation; the Dominican Republic announced an AI Ethics Code and will hold the pro tempore presidency.
key_provisions_or_claims: Over 20 LAC delegations convened to advance implementation of the UNESCO Recommendation on AI Ethics
Dominican Republic announced forthcoming approval of a national AI Code of Ethics
Dominican Republic assumes Pro Tempore Presidency of the regional mechanism
Continues earlier summits in Santiago (2023) and Montevideo (2024) toward a common regional roadmap
EU pledges cooperation via the EU-LAC digital alliance AI component
